title: LX (Linear Executable, OS/2 2.x) signature
summary: LX is a variant of LE used by OS/2 2.x. Magic: 'MZ' at offset 0, with 'LX' at e_lfanew offset.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LX is similar to LE but with some OS/2-specific extensions.
LX is used by OS/2 2.x 32-bit executables.
